summary: Comprehensive testing of 7 Financial Management improvements. All 19 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI elements verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Quota generation tests created quotas for 07/2027, 08/2027, 09/2027, 10/2027 months
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 finance improvements fully tested and working. Paginated API returns {items, total, skip, limit}. CSV export uses semicolon delimiter with UTF-8 BOM. DRE shows category percentages with progress bars. Dashboard has clickable finance widget. Quota generation shows detailed results (created, skipped, total_value).

improvement_1_date_range_filters.backend: GET /api/finances/transactions accepts start_date and end_date params
improvement_1_date_range_filters.frontend: Date inputs with data-testid=start-date-filter and end-date-filter present and functional

improvement_2_text_search.frontend: Search input with data-testid=search-input, debounced search working, shows 'FILTROS ATIVOS' badge

improvement_3_real_pagination.backend: Response format: {items: [...], total: N, skip: N, limit: N}
improvement_3_real_pagination.frontend: Pagination controls (prev-page-btn, next-page-btn) working, shows page numbers

improvement_4_csv_export.backend: GET /api/finances/transactions/csv returns CSV with semicolon delimiter, UTF-8 BOM, respects all filters

improvement_5_dre_percentages.backend: GET /api/finances/dre returns receitas_por_categoria and despesas_por_categoria with numeric values
improvement_5_dre_percentages.frontend: DRE tab shows percentages (e.g., '42%') next to category values with progress bars

improvement_6_dashboard_widget.frontend: Dashboard shows finance-summary-widget with Receitas, Despesas, Saldo values, clickable to navigate to /financeiro

improvement_7_quota_generation_details.frontend: Settings tab shows gen-result panel with gen-created, gen-skipped, gen-total-value after generation
